name: look
description: Check a project in one call instead of sampling frames: overlay text off the frame, cut off by its box, spilling out of its box, inside the 5% title-safe margin, crossing the captions while one shows (where montaj draws them, measured per style), over the apps' bottom controls or right-side buttons (tall phone frames only; each safe-area issue says how far to move the text), overlays whose text crosses, three or more overlays with text in one top slot, text whose font fell back to serif, a label over the 3D part it marks, items outside the timeline or past the footage, missing overlay files, black stretches, overlays with no footage under them (overlay only), items a full-frame one hides, an overlay with no motion, no exit or only linear motion (from its code: Motion's helpers give all three), text under the floors a phone reads (36 px, titles 72 px, on the 1080 canvas). Picks the times itself (cut seams, overlay in and out, caption changes, even samples; at most 12) unless at is given. Read-only, renders no frame. image adds one contact sheet. On a carousel it checks the slides instead of a timeline: text off the slide, cut off or spilling out of its box, text that crosses other text, a slide with no image, a headline hard to read on its image; image adds one composite of the slides (768 px wide).

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {ok, slides (carousel), overlays (measured), unmeasured?, issues?: ["<t>s <id>: <issue>"], more?, sheet?, times?}. detail adds every issue, times, items, notes, wallMs. A carousel: issues are "slide n: <issue>", detail adds shown and wallMs.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: at
params.description: Look at these timeline seconds instead (at most 12; 8 with image). On a carousel: slide numbers (1-based, at most 12) to check and render instead of all slides.

params.name: image
params.description: Also make one contact sheet of at most 8 of the times (3 across, 360 px tiles) in render/samples. On a carousel: one composite of the slides, 768 px wide.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the times, each item checked and the wall time.
